name: Justice, Adam Smith
bioAdditions: Pelletreau prints Adam Smith's will of 12 June 1704, which leaves 'all estate to his only son Edmund Smith' (not probated) (S1). The Introduction says 'Adam is said to have died in 1720' (S2), against the tree's 2 July 1726. Adam therefore cannot be the father of James Smith of Moriches, and the tree's pairing of Adam with Elizabeth Thompson is wrong: she was Job's wife (S3).

conflicts.siteValue: Tree: father of James Smith; husband of Elizabeth Thompson
conflicts.foundValue: Only son Edmund (1704 will); Elizabeth Thompson was wife of Job Smith
conflicts.assessment: Remove Adam as James's father and Elizabeth's husband.
